Security.evtx.title: Windows Security Event Log
Security.evtx.role: Primary forensic repository for authentication, user rights assignment, account management, audit policy changes, process creation (EID 4688), and object access auditing.
Security.evtx.retention: Fixed maximum size (typically 128MB to 2GB in Enterprise). Wrap-around overwrite policy.
Security.evtx.audit_policy: Enable Audit Process Creation (with CommandLine auditing), Audit Logon, Audit Account Management, and Audit Special Logon.

System.evtx.title: Windows System Event Log
System.evtx.role: Contains events logged by Windows system components, service control manager, hardware changes, kernel drivers, and system startup/shutdown.
System.evtx.audit_policy: Monitor Service Control Manager events for unexpected service binaries executing from temp or user-writable directories.

Application.evtx.title: Windows Application Event Log
Application.evtx.role: Logs software errors, application crashes (WerFault / Event 1000), MSI installer activity (Event 11707), and third-party utility telemetry.
Application.evtx.audit_policy: Review application crash dumps and installer errors for signs of memory corruption exploitation or DLL side-loading.

Sysmon.evtx.title: Microsoft Sysmon Operational Telemetry Log
Sysmon.evtx.role: Premier endpoint telemetry sensor providing detailed process lineage, network sockets, raw disk access, process memory injection, and pipe/DNS activity.
Sysmon.evtx.retention: Typically configured to 64MB - 1GB by SOC engineering.
Sysmon.evtx.audit_policy: Deploy a comprehensive community Sysmon configuration (SwiftOnSecurity or Olaf Hartong modular config).

PowerShell.evtx.title: Microsoft PowerShell Operational Log
PowerShell.evtx.role: Deep PowerShell execution log capturing de-obfuscated script blocks (EID 4104), interactive command invocation (EID 4103), and AMSI bypass attempts.
PowerShell.evtx.retention: Default 15MB. Highly recommended to increase to 256MB+.
PowerShell.evtx.audit_policy: Enforce Group Policy for PowerShell Script Block Logging, Module Logging, and Transcription.

Microsoft-Windows-TaskScheduler/Operatio.title: Windows Task Scheduler Operational Log
Microsoft-Windows-TaskScheduler/Operatio.role: Monitors creation, execution, and modification of scheduled tasks (primary persistence mechanism for lateral movement and C2 triggers).
Microsoft-Windows-TaskScheduler/Operatio.audit_policy: Enable Operational channel logging in Task Scheduler event log properties.

Microsoft-Windows-WMI-Activity/Operation.title: WMI Activity Operational Log
Microsoft-Windows-WMI-Activity/Operation.role: Forensic log capturing WMI query execution, provider initialization, and persistence via rogue WMI Event Consumers (__EventFilter, __EventConsumer).
Microsoft-Windows-WMI-Activity/Operation.retention: Default 1MB. Highly sensitive indicator for fileless WMI persistence.
Microsoft-Windows-WMI-Activity/Operation.audit_policy: Alert immediately on Event ID 5861 for unexpected permanent consumer registration.

Microsoft-Windows-BackgroundActivityMode.title: Background Activity Moderator (BAM) Log
Microsoft-Windows-BackgroundActivityMode.role: Kernel power management telemetry recording exact execution timestamps of user and desktop applications.
Microsoft-Windows-BackgroundActivityMode.retention: Correlate with BAM registry entries (SYSTEM hive) during dead-box forensic disk triage.
Microsoft-Windows-BackgroundActivityMode.audit_policy: System kernel feature active on Windows 10/11 and Server 2019+.

Microsoft-Windows-TerminalServices-Local.title: TerminalServices Local Session Manager Log
Microsoft-Windows-TerminalServices-Local.role: Records interactive and Remote Desktop (RDP) session connect, disconnect, and reconnect transitions with source IP mapping.
Microsoft-Windows-TerminalServices-Local.audit_policy: Correlate with Security.evtx Event 4624 (Logon Type 10) to confirm client source addresses.

Microsoft-Windows-TerminalServices-Remot.title: TerminalServices Remote Connection Manager Log
Microsoft-Windows-TerminalServices-Remot.role: Tracks incoming network connections to RDP listeners, TLS handshakes, and early credential negotiation.
Microsoft-Windows-TerminalServices-Remot.audit_policy: EID 1149 records client machine name and client IP before user credentials are confirmed.

Microsoft-Windows-RemoteDesktopServices-.title: Remote Desktop Services RdpCoreTS Log
Microsoft-Windows-RemoteDesktopServices-.role: Core RDP network stack logging TCP connection establishment, TLS negotiation, and external brute-force connection attempts.
Microsoft-Windows-RemoteDesktopServices-.audit_policy: Examine EID 131 to detect external port scanning and internet-facing RDP brute-force scans.

Microsoft-Windows-SMBClient/Security.evt.title: SMB Client Security Log
Microsoft-Windows-SMBClient/Security.evt.role: Captures SMB client authentication events, unencrypted shares, and SMB signing downgrade attempts.
Microsoft-Windows-SMBClient/Security.evt.audit_policy: Require SMB signing and SMB encryption across all domain endpoints.

Microsoft-Windows-SMBServer/Security.evt.title: SMB Server Security Log
Microsoft-Windows-SMBServer/Security.evt.role: Records inbound SMB connections, administrative share accesses (ADMIN$, C$), and lateral tool drops.
Microsoft-Windows-SMBServer/Security.evt.audit_policy: Correlate with Security EID 5140 (Network share object accessed).

Microsoft-Windows-WinRM/Operational.evtx.title: Windows Remote Management (WinRM) Operational Log
Microsoft-Windows-WinRM/Operational.evtx.role: Logs incoming PowerShell Remoting and WinRM management sessions, command dispatches, and WS-Management requests.
Microsoft-Windows-WinRM/Operational.evtx.audit_policy: Essential telemetry for detecting PowerShell Remoting (Enter-PSSession, Invoke-Command) lateral movement.

DNS Server.evtx.title: Windows DNS Server Event Log
DNS Server.evtx.role: Records DNS queries, zone transfers, dynamic updates, and suspicious external resolver lookups.
DNS Server.evtx.audit_policy: Enable DNS analytical logging for command-and-control tunnel and data exfiltration detection.

Microsoft-Windows-Bits-Client/Operationa.title: Background Intelligent Transfer Service (BITS) Operational Log
Microsoft-Windows-Bits-Client/Operationa.role: Exposes BITS job creations, downloads, and notification callbacks commonly abused for stealthy file download cradles and persistence.
Microsoft-Windows-Bits-Client/Operationa.audit_policy: Monitor BITS jobs created by non-system accounts with external URLs.

Microsoft-Windows-NTLM/Operational.evtx.title: NTLM Operational Security Log
Microsoft-Windows-NTLM/Operational.evtx.role: Detailed telemetry on NTLMv1 and NTLMv2 authentication requests, NTLM relay attacks, and PetitPotam co-ercion attempts.
Microsoft-Windows-NTLM/Operational.evtx.audit_policy: Enable Network security: Restrict NTLM: Audit NTLM authentication in this domain.

Microsoft-Windows-LSA/Operational.evtx.title: Local Security Authority (LSA) Operational Log
Microsoft-Windows-LSA/Operational.evtx.role: Captures LSA Protected Process Light (PPL) violations, credential guard alerts, and unauthorized attempts to open handle to lsass.exe.
Microsoft-Windows-LSA/Operational.evtx.audit_policy: Enforce LSA Protection (RunAsPPL=1) and monitor LSA Operational channel for Mimikatz dumping attempts.

Microsoft-Windows-Directory-Services-SAM.title: Directory Services SAM Operational Log
Microsoft-Windows-Directory-Services-SAM.role: Records Active Directory Security Account Manager RPC queries, BloodHound/SharpHound reconnaissance, and mass user enumeration.
Microsoft-Windows-Directory-Services-SAM.audit_policy: Restrict remote SAM clients via GPO: Network access: Restrict clients allowed to make remote calls to SAM.

Microsoft-Windows-Windows Defender/Opera.title: Microsoft Defender Antivirus Operational Log
Microsoft-Windows-Windows Defender/Opera.role: Exposes real-time threat detections, quarantined payloads, AMSI blocks, and tamper protection overrides.
Microsoft-Windows-Windows Defender/Opera.audit_policy: Alert immediately on EID 5001 (Real-time protection disabled by adversary).

Microsoft-Windows-CodeIntegrity/Operatio.title: Windows Code Integrity Operational Log
Microsoft-Windows-CodeIntegrity/Operatio.role: Crucial driver and binary security log capturing unsigned kernel drivers (BYOVD), HVCI blocks, and Windows Defender Application Control (WDAC) violations.
Microsoft-Windows-CodeIntegrity/Operatio.audit_policy: Deploy WDAC in audit or enforce mode to catch Bring Your Own Vulnerable Driver (BYOVD) rootkits.

Microsoft-Windows-AppLocker/EXE and DLL..title: AppLocker Executable and DLL Log
Microsoft-Windows-AppLocker/EXE and DLL..role: Records executable and DLL execution blocks and audits enforced by AppLocker application whitelisting.
Microsoft-Windows-AppLocker/EXE and DLL..audit_policy: Enforce AppLocker rule collections to block LOLBIN abuse from temporary and user-writable directories.

Microsoft-Windows-AppLocker/MSI and Scri.title: AppLocker MSI and Script Log
Microsoft-Windows-AppLocker/MSI and Scri.role: Captures scripts (.vbs, .js, .ps1, .bat) and installer packages blocked or audited by AppLocker.
Microsoft-Windows-AppLocker/MSI and Scri.audit_policy: Prevent malicious Windows Script Host (wscript, cscript) execution.

Microsoft-Windows-Windows Firewall With.title: Windows Defender Firewall Log
Microsoft-Windows-Windows Firewall With.role: Records firewall rule additions, port openings, and firewall state tampering by malicious software.
Microsoft-Windows-Windows Firewall With.audit_policy: Monitor unexpected inbound port openings created by command-line utilities (netsh advfirewall).

Microsoft-Windows-DriverFrameworks-UserM.title: User-Mode Driver Framework (UMDF) Operational Log
Microsoft-Windows-DriverFrameworks-UserM.role: Premier forensic log for tracking USB device connections, serial numbers, drive letter assignments, and disconnect times.
Microsoft-Windows-DriverFrameworks-UserM.retention: Default disabled. Must be enabled for USB forensics.
Microsoft-Windows-DriverFrameworks-UserM.audit_policy: Enable channel via wevtutil or GPO for critical workstations to capture data exfiltration via removable drives.

Microsoft-Windows-Kernel-PnP/Configurati.title: Kernel Plug and Play Configuration Log
Microsoft-Windows-Kernel-PnP/Configurati.role: Tracks hardware device installation, vendor IDs, hardware IDs, and driver binding.
Microsoft-Windows-Kernel-PnP/Configurati.audit_policy: Inspect device configuration events to prove physical device insertion.

Microsoft-Windows-VHDMP/Operational.evtx.title: VHD Miniport Driver (VHDMP) Operational Log
Microsoft-Windows-VHDMP/Operational.evtx.role: Records virtual disk (.vhd, .vhdx, .iso) mount and unmount operations commonly used in phishing container execution (Mark-of-the-Web bypass).
Microsoft-Windows-VHDMP/Operational.evtx.audit_policy: Alert on ISO/VHD mounts originating from Downloads or temp folders.
